repos_data.description: Self-hosted Expo OTA Updates alternative to EAS Update, on the official Expo Updates protocol. Multi-app dashboard, progressive rollouts, instant rollbacks, and per-update crashes, metrics and logs from every device via expo-observe. Your bucket, your CDN, your data. Formerly expo-open-ota.
Ship iOS and Android apps from your AI agent. MCP server for App Store Connect, Google Play Console and Expo EAS.
